Hi Alex,

I noticed Shadowbox's org crossed the 200k token mark this week — congrats on the traction. If that sounds valuable, here are a few 30-minute options (all PT):
- Wed May 17 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed May 17 — 15:00–15:30
- Thu May 18 — 09:00–09:30

Agenda (short):
- Quick usage profile review (5m)
- Recommended runtime/config tweaks (10m)
- Integrations & rollout checklist (10m)
- Q&A and next steps (5m)

I can send a calendar invite for whichever slot works best. If you want a deeper technical touch, I can loop in Soojin from our CS team.

Cheers,
